Name: Fast and Stacked
Author: ISITongue
Description:
[b]Fast and Stacked[/b] is a simple quality of life mod that lets you quickly send items from your inventory into nearby chests.
Open a chest and use the [b]Fast Stack ON/OFF[/b] button to choose if this chest should be used by Fast Stack.
Then simply press the Fast Stack key ([b]P by default[/b]) and the mod will search for enabled chests around you and automatically transfer matching items.
The important part is that Fast and Stacked doesnt randomly dump everything into your storage.
An item will only be moved into a chest if this chest already contains the same item. This means your existing chest organisation stays intact.
For exemple, if one of your enabled chests already contains Stone, all matching Stone from your inventory can be sent there. But if the chest never contained Wood, Fast Stack won't suddenly put Wood inside it.
[list]
-Enable or disable Fast Stack individually for each chest-Quick stack with one key-Searches nearby chests automatically-Default range of 10 tiles-Only transfers items already present in the destination chest-Can create additional stacks of the same item when the existing stack is full-Tools, weapons, rings, clothes and other non-stackable equipment are ignored-Small animated transfer feed shows what was moved-Hotkey, range and some behaviors can be changed in the config[/list]Fast and Stacked is mainly made for farms with lots of storage, where manually opening every chest just to put a few items back gets annoying pretty fast.
